## Passage card — `perdomo-et-al-2020-performative-prediction-q001` — Prediction changes its target
^perdomo-et-al-2020-performative-prediction-q001

> **Paraphrase (not a quotation):** The abstract defines predictions as performative when decisions based on them influence the outcomes predicted. It introduces performative stability relative to future outcomes resulting from acting on predictions and describes a risk-minimisation research framework. The abstract reports convergence results, but no theorem, assumptions, proof, experiment or full article is independently admitted by this bounded reading. The stated problem supplies a technical neighbour for institutional feedback, not proof of every social feedback mechanism.

- **Locator:** PMLR119 proceedings page, unpaginated Abstract; article metadata7599–7609 is bibliographic only.
